businesses.business: collector vehicle insurance and automotive enthusiast services

offering_description.value: Provides specialty insurance for classic, collector and enthusiast vehicles, mainly through independent agents and direct to owners. Also runs membership, valuation tools, media, events and a marketplace serving car enthusiasts.

primary_products.value: collector vehicle insurance policies; vehicle club memberships; enthusiast media and merchandise

primary_services.value: insurance underwriting and policy administration; vehicle valuation tools; roadside assistance; collector car events; online auction marketplace

customer_segment.value: B2C: classic and collector car owners and automotive enthusiasts; B2B: independent insurance agents, event sponsors, advertisers, and partner insurers

end_markets.value: specialty auto insurance; collector vehicles; automotive enthusiast market

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums on collector vehicle policies; commissions or management fees: commissions and fees for placing and managing policies underwritten by partner carriers; subscription: Hagerty Drivers Club memberships; transaction or usage fees: marketplace auction fees and event ticket sales; advertising: sponsorships and media advertising
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; commissions or management fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: managing general agent placing collector vehicle policies with carriers, sold to car owners; software / platform: valuation tools and online marketplace for enthusiasts; service provider: memberships, events and media for enthusiasts
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: US primary, plus Canada, UK, and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: collector vehicle insurance, memberships, valuation, marketplace, events and media

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents selling collector policies; direct sales: direct to owners via website and call centers; partners / resellers: partnerships with automakers and enthusiast organizations; online: marketplace and membership sign-ups online
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; direct sales; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance producer licensing and underwriting regulated by state insurance departments and foreign insurance regulators
